Drug Peddler Detained Under PIT-NDPS Act in Jammu and Kashmir

A drug peddler has been jailed in Kathua, Jammu and Kashmir, under the Prevention of Illicit Traffic in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (PIT-NDPS) Act. The specific details of the individual's alleged offenses and the duration of the detention were not provided in the coverage. The PIT-NDPS Act allows for detention without trial for individuals involved in illicit drug trafficking.
